description: Draw a glowing sunset road in 12 lines of canvas
commands:
const c = document.querySelector('canvas')
const g = c.getContext('2d')

const sky = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 300)
sky.addColorStop(0, '#07070d')
sky.addColorStop(1, '#ff7a00')
g.fillStyle = sky
g.fillRect(0, 0, 480, 300)

g.fillStyle = '#2c3444'
g.beginPath()
g.moveTo(240, 300)
g.lineTo(120, 480)
g.lineTo(360, 480)
g.fill()
